full_prompt_en: A square expressive oil-painting-like portrait shows a dark-haired man resting his hand against his face amid a crowded assortment of painted animals, vessels, and plant shapes. The man sits in the lower center of the selected panel, wearing a pale gray shirt beneath a near-black sleeveless vest. His shoulders bend slightly forward, and one elbow supports the raised hand whose fingers touch his lips and chin. He looks off toward the left with a pensive, somewhat tired expression. Deep red and orange planes shape the nose, cheeks, and eye sockets, while the brow and jaw carry cooler brown shadows. A broad yellow-orange circular area behind the head makes a bright backdrop to the dark hair without forming a clean empty halo. On the left, a pale large animal head enters from the edge above clusters of yellow flowers and rounded fruit. At the right, a pink curled animal-like form sits behind the man's shoulder, surrounded by small painted containers, leaves, and fragmentary faces or figures. The upper band is packed with additional irregular shapes and warm color patches, creating little uninterrupted background. Brushwork changes across the image: the face has broad flat passages with firm dark contours, while surrounding objects overlap in smaller, rougher strokes. Light appears diffuse and warm from the upper-left, brightening the shirt and yellow backdrop but leaving folds of the vest deep. The overall composition anchors a quiet thinker inside a lively, cluttered color field, balancing warm red and gold against dark green and black.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、表现性的油画式肖像呈现一名黑发男子，手支着脸，周围挤满绘出的动物、容器和植物形态。男子坐在所选单图下部中央，浅灰衬衫外穿近黑色无袖背心。肩膀稍向前弯，一只手肘支撑抬起的手，手指碰到嘴唇与下巴。他望向左侧，神情沉思且略显疲惫。深红与橙色平面塑造鼻子、脸颊和眼窝，眉骨与下颌带较冷的棕色阴影。头后宽阔的黄橙色圆形区域衬托深发，却没有形成干净空白的光环。左侧一只浅色大动物的头从边缘进入，下方是成簇黄花和圆形果实。右侧一只粉色蜷曲的动物状形体坐在男子肩后，周围有绘制的小容器、叶片及残缺的脸或人形。上方横带挤满更多不规则形状与暖色色块，几乎没有连续空背景。画面的笔触随区域变化：脸部用宽阔平涂区域和明确深色轮廓表现，周围物件则以更细小、更粗糙的笔触互相遮叠。光似乎从左上漫射而来，照亮衬衫与黄色背景，使背心褶皱仍然深暗。整体构图把安静的沉思者固定在活跃、拥挤的色彩区域里，以暖红与金黄平衡深绿和黑色。
style_prompt_en: Expressive figurative painting builds forms from broad, slightly angular color planes and uneven dark contours. Saturated ocher, tomato red, warm pink, and pale cream collide with moss green, brown, and deep black. The focal region is modeled more firmly, while peripheral marks become smaller, rougher, and more fragmentary. A bright circular area behind the central mass establishes contrast without emptying the surrounding field. Layered objects and organic fragments fill nearly every corner, giving the surface a collage-like density. Light is warm and diffuse; the drama comes from color adjacency and dark planes rather than a hard spotlight. The overall effect is psychologically still at the center but visually busy around it.
style_prompt_zh: 表现性具象绘画以宽阔、略有棱角的色面和不均匀深色轮廓塑造形体。饱和赭黄、番茄红、暖粉与浅乳白同苔绿、棕色和深黑相碰。焦点区域塑形更明确，周缘笔痕则变得更小、更粗涩，也更破碎。中央大形体后方的亮色圆形区域建立反差，却没有清空周围色域。层层物件和有机碎片几乎填满每个角落，使表面具有拼贴般的密度。光线温暖而漫射；戏剧性来自相邻颜色与深色平面，而不是硬聚光。整体效果是中心心理状态安静，四周视觉上却十分繁忙。
theme_en: A thoughtful dark-haired man amid a crowded painted assortment of animals and objects
theme_zh: 一名沉思的黑发男子坐在动物和物件交织的拥挤绘画背景前
name: Nicole Eisenman
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
